description: Create/list/archive personal/workspace/project; membership roles; scoped audit actor IDs.
Authorized member can join/view/comment on team research sessions; unapproved member receives 403 including for sources/artifacts.
Distinguish personal/team/global memory. Global requires explicit opt-in and provenance; no implicit cross-workspace leak.
Auth may be demo-safe locally but must genuinely enforce role boundaries; production provider replaceable.
Search and retrieve real papers via arXiv/OpenAlex (stable DOI/arXiv/work IDs, citation relationships, metadata, licensing/compliance, sync timestamps).
Index a bounded but real paper corpus, embed/search with pluggable embedding provider or deterministic ranking baseline; visually every semantic paper dot maps 1:1 to a paper record.

Papiers connector reads actual authorized notes/highlights/papers via documented CLI; source references and retrieval status preserved. Handle unauthenticated/unsupported read operations. No unsupported write assumed.

Retrieval merges public literature, personal notes and approved team knowledge while maintaining provenance, source quality, access context, time and distinct ranks; citation links are not semantic similarity edges.
Allow researcher's real note selection and correction; actively distinguish annotation/judgment from mere bookmarking.

Turn a goal into objective, variables, competing hypotheses, controlled protocol(s), metrics (units/direction), success/failure criteria, safety/resource limits, known uncertainties, possible dependencies.
User reviews/edits plan; version all approvals/changes; Gemini model output must be schema-validated proposal only.
Plans can include multiple candidate experiments and a literature gap check; reject unsupported sources. Each experiment has deterministic evaluator specification.

Agent chooses experiment, executes actual code/plugin in isolated bounded environment, collects stdout/stderr, code commit hash, dataset ID/hash, evaluator version, seed, runtime, metrics and artifacts.
Autonomous research loop uses results to keep/discard/modify hypothesis or schedule child; errors/failed experiments are durable events.
Support resume, retry/idempotence, cancel, timeout, queue, status, resource budget, concurrency and tool-call trace.

Domain plugins: real deterministic camera coverage/viewpoint selection **and** pluggable image/scene method comparison (may use precomputed real visual artifacts under honest provenance). Do not assert actual 3DGS scores from a coverage proxy.
Typed nodes (paper, objective, problem, hypothesis, method, run, claim, evidence, human judgment, skill, agent, researcher, project) and directed typed edges with source, status and confidence.
Detect new blockers based on measured threshold, unexpected failure, conflicting evidence or missing technique; attach evidence and deduplicate against prior questions.
Create a *queued actionable child investigation*, not just a node: completion criteria, metric, literature context, parent dependency, priority score, assignee, action state.
Prioritize competing agendas using value of information, expected unlock impact, uncertainty, cost and human priorities; handle cycles/duplicate tasks.
Mark parent unblocked only after child completion AND parent-side verification. Maintain source lineage for every claim.
Persistent inspectable individual profile of research priorities, expertise, methodological rules, assumptions, evidence and confidence; edit/delete/disable with consent.
Compile sourced annotations or direct feedback into falsifiable proposals with provenance, applicability scope, alternatives, tests and approval; human note is never automatically a fact.

For the SAME feasible candidate experiment set, independently score (a) unguided policy and (b) Papiers/human-conditioned policy; derive `s_guided(a) = s_u(a) + w · (s_c(a) − s_u(a))`; rank argmax among feasible candidates. See normative `02_CFG_GUIDANCE_POLICY.md` for calibrations/extrapolation/edge cases.

Expose/record both score vectors, guidance weight, selected action, score explanation, snapshot and resulting run; allow weight changes and counterfactual choices. Constraints are hard filters, never overridden by extrapolation.
Missing/unapproved/no-authorized-human context: policy safely falls back to unguided; score failures marked and not silently imputed as grounded judgments.

Investigator, skeptic, methodologist and human-aligned critic propose falsifiable competing interpretations, confounders and discriminating experiments; same orchestration harness may implement all roles.
Log disagreement graph and reasons; no majority-vote "truth." Unresolved contradictions stay unresolved until evidence arrives.
Disagreement between actual team members can be converted into mutually agreed comparison under same evaluation criteria.

Two distinct, consented researchers’ Papiers-grounded annotations can produce explicit, provenance-linked opposing claims and a test discriminating them. Never blend their individual profiles into an invented collective opinion.
Ask a targeted question only when the answer can change hypothesis, evaluator, resource allocation or next action. Include evidence packet, alternatives, uncertainty and expected consequence.
Human can approve/redirect/reject/annotate; must persist intervention, action before/after, rationale/source, and author. Other independent work can proceed during wait.
Expertise routing selects authorized opt-in researchers based on contributed work; human can decline; no guessed sensitive traits; resulting answer scoped to access policy.
Checkpoint prior policy decision; create true unguided `w=0` and guided `w=selected` branches with common dataset, evaluator, seed/budget where applicable; both have independent run/action histories.
Compare actual outcomes when executed. If one is pending, say `not_evaluated` instead of inventing branch result. Show confounds where objectives or resources differ.
Allow rewind and re-run an alternative guidance weight or researcher correction from compatible checkpoint; preserve predecessor and all provenance.
Durable shared sessions/events visible to authorized teammates; live join, comment/correct, collaborate without restarting agent; preserve agent/human attribution.
Extract candidate lesson/skill from evidence + human insight; include applicability, test, provenance, reviewer, validation/version, known counterexamples and access scope.
Promote to reviewed skills only via evidence/reviewer policy; other agent can retrieve and explicitly apply skill. Show whether transfer was tested and passed/failed.
Identify overlapping investigations and relevant work across authorized team projects, with opt-in suggestions not automatic confidential disclosure.
Form a transfer hypothesis from validated method to new project; run compatible evaluation or mark transfer untested; no unverified global generalization.
New contradicting evidence triggers graph propagation `disputed/needs_revalidation` to dependent claims and project alerts; queue revalidation protocol and keep historic versions.

Compare at least two selectable research strategies with recorded trial conditions, budgets and outcomes (e.g. w=0 vs w=1 / skepticism timing / retrieval policy). Produce guarded policy suggestion, not automatic unrestricted fine-tune.
Version strategies and ability to roll back. Scope to bounded supported evaluations; report confidence and inconclusive studies honestly.
Real Gemini server-side model calls for structured scientific plans, judgment compiler and optional policy scoring. Store model/version/status/cost/budget metadata and Pydantic validation errors.
Provider-swappable interface for other LLMs. No mock marked Gemini; offline fixture mode labeled. Retriable limits/errors visible.
Relational Postgres/Tiger tables for people/workspaces, graph, sources, runs, policies, judgments, skills, forks, approvals and ACL.
Real Timescale hypertables for timestamped research events and per-run metric samples; continuous aggregate with meaningful minute bucket stats and auditably queryable counts/durations.
Dashboard reads actual DB analytics; fallback Postgres/local mode clearly identified. Do not fabricate activity metrics, scale or compression statistics.

React/TypeScript app with immersive Three.js/R3F semantic paper point cloud; cosmos.gl used where beneficial for GPU graph layout/interaction. User reference aesthetic is **glowing volumetric dense points**, not diagram circles.
Paper node select/search/filter/fly-to, orbit/zoom, source inspector, typed research layers, sparse edges on selection; atmospheric glow excluded from count.

Research Lab, Agenda, Paper/Claim Inspector, Evidence and Timeline, Judgment Compiler/scoring view, PARALLAX, Fork Explorer, River Team, Researcher Intelligence, Portfolio, Meta Experiments, Settings/Integrations all functional.
New blocker event visibly grows linked research node and opens actionable child; views show actual run state, evidence/permission and measurements.
Responsive layouts, reduced motion, keyboard access, WebGL-unavailable fallback; screenshot regression vs references and performance instrumentation.

Research Lab includes a physical 3D experiment viewer for supported real point-cloud/mesh/3DGS artifacts with camera orbit, alternate-view comparison and visually marked uncertain/unobserved regions when provided by evaluator data. Artifact provenance is explicit; no synthetic regions claimed as measured. Selecting a supported uncertain region can create a proposed actionable research problem, subject to normal evidence checks.
Clean setup with documented local/hosted provider modes, migrations, seed of clearly labeled sample data, CI checks, load and permission tests, controlled demo replay.
Every route and primary control implemented and tested (no dead controls or screen-only mock). API/version compatibility verified via contract tests and fixture/live modes.
Integration diagnostics show actual Papiers/Gemini/Tiger health/status and `data_mode` at point of use; no claim sponsor category compliance without actual functional use.
Private proprietary APORIA repo, no project MIT license unless team decides, third-party notices preserved; code ownership among team contributors to be agreed independently.
